blocking_findings.detail:
cfg_attr doc attributes with trivia between doc and equals evade detection, e.g. #[cfg_attr(feature = "docs", doc
 = include_str!("examples.md"))] or a block comment between tokens. Detection uses literal `doc =`/`doc=` substring; code has no token normalization/parser. Rust accepts whitespace/newlines/comments between these tokens, so compiled rustdoc input can be missed. Add an adversarial fixture; normalize tokens or fail closed on any cfg_attr containing a doc meta item. This means current guard is not yet sufficient basis for disabling doctests.

The scanner reads only tracked .rs files (plus Markdown) while checking Cargo target src_path only for tracked existence. Non-.rs files used through include! or an explicitly configured target source are not scanned as Rust docs. Consider tracking all Cargo source paths regardless extension and resolving tracked include! paths, or fail closed on source inclusion forms that point outside scanned .rs files.
